Test-only public RSA key from a private fixture certificate. No private key is checked in. rsa-oaep-expected.bin is an independent RFC 8017 OAEP-SHA1 calculation using Python hashlib and modular exponentiation: seed bytes 0..19; plaintext `secret` plus NUL XOR ASCII nonce `12345678901234567890`; empty label. Exponent 65537. Never use this deterministic seed for real authentication.
